text:
maya: hitting a weird inconsistency with the Python async client and error objects when auth fails (401)
maya: sometimes I get an HttpError with status=401 and raw_text available, other times a generic ApiError with only .message. not sure why
sam: are you hitting a proxied token refresh flow or the hosted API?
maya: hosted API, simple call: `await client.responses.create(...)` using async client
alex: can you paste the stack / minimal repro? most 4xx get parsed into our ApiError wrapper but we intended to preserve raw body on parse failures
maya: repro snippet: 
```py
async with RedwoodClient(api_key=MYKEY) as client:
    try:
        await client.responses.create(model="gpt-4all", input="hi")
    except Exception as e:
        print(type(e), repr(e))
        # sometimes shows HttpError(status=401, body=b'Unauthorized')
        # sometimes ApiError('unexpected json', ...)
```
sam: ok that matches a bug I saw — if the error payload is JSON we try to parse into ValidationError shape and return ApiError(error_details=...), but if the parse raises we drop the raw bytes in the wrapper
maya: dropping raw bytes is the worst for debugging. can we ensure exception has `.raw_body` and `.status_code` always? even if parse succeeds
ale: agree. also the type hints for client methods currently only annotate `-> Response` but the exceptions in the stub are not union-typed (no `Raises` info). makes it hard for typed code to catch specific exceptions
lee-bot: /link https://github.com/redwood-inference/py-sdk/issues/542 (auto: created issue for exc.raw_body-and-typing) :robot_face:
sam: feature request: ApiError should expose `raw_body: Optional[bytes]`, `status_code: int`, and `error_json: Optional[Dict[str, Any]]` — even if parse succeeds, keep the original bytes
maya: also need better retry guidance: 401 should not be auto-retried by default, but some of our internal retry middleware treats anything non-5xx as non-retryable — but when using short-lived tokens we want an optional token-refresh hook to retry once
ale: agreed. current client retry policy is opaque in YAML config and not surfaced in SDK docs. request: allow `retry_policy` param or `on_auth_failure` hook in async client
sam: low-level: ensure aihttp session isn't leaked when an exception is raised during __aenter__; I hit `Unclosed connector` leaks when my test triggered a parser error in response handling
maya: oh yeah that was me — the wrapper that handles parse errors swallows after closing stream but not the session sometimes
lee-bot: /assign @alex @sam (auto: assigned)
ale: plan: 1) guarantee Exception model with fields `status_code`, `raw_body` (bytes as base64 in repr?), `error_json` (if parse ok) 2) update type stubs so functions declare `raises: ApiError | HttpError` (we'll approximate in docstrings / typing comments for now) 3) add `auth_retry_hook` param on client init 4) fix async context manager to close session on any path
sam: I'll open PR for the exception shape change + tests that assert raw body preserved for both JSON and non-JSON payloads
maya: test I'll add: simulate a 401 with malformed JSON and confirm exception.raw_body == b'...'; also confirm no connector leak
ale: thanks. can someone add a short note in SDK migration guide — breaking change: ApiError structure extended but backwards compatible (attrs kept)
maya: thanks all. one more tiny DX ask: when printing exceptions during dev we should include a one-line hint: `Tip: set REDWOOD_DEBUG=1 to include raw response body` — saves time
sam: nice UX touch, will add to PR
lee-bot: closing loop: issue #542 updated with assigned PR and checklist
maya: sweet, thanks for the quick sync :heart:
